Title: NO COMMENT
Body (HTML):
NO COMMENT by Assaf — 100 ML

This one does not try to impress you. It just does. No Comment is a women's fragrance built on one idea: let the quality speak and skip the noise.

It opens with the warm, spiced energy of pink pepper, bergamot, and cardamom — clean and put together. Orange blossom, almond, and ginger add a soft smoothness underneath. The heart brings in frankincense, myrrh, ylang-ylang, and cinnamon — resinous, warm, and rich. The base lands quietly with vanilla, patchouli, cedarwood, and sandalwood — the sweetness barely whispers, and the woods do most of the talking.

Nothing fights for attention. Everything has a job. And what you're left with is a warm, grounded trail that just feels right on the skin.
